description: Unique record identifier. Generated server-side on insert. Never sent by Android.
validation_rules: Must be valid UUID v4. Reject duplicates.

description: Owner of the record. Extracted from the JWT bearer token on every request. Android never sends this field.

sdk_field: Varies per table  see sdk_field column on each row
description: When the measurement was taken on the device. Android system clock in UTC milliseconds. Primary time for charting and export.
validation_rules: Must be > 0. Must be <= server receive time + 60000 ms (60s clock skew allowance). Reject future timestamps beyond 60s.

description: When the API server received and stored the record. Set by server on insert. Never trusted from client.
validation_rules: Set automatically on insert. Immutable. Read-only.
Allowed values: manual | continuous. Reject all others.

description: Client-generated idempotency key. Android creates this UUID before sending and stores it locally. If same sync_id arrives twice (retry), server inserts once and returns 200 on second call instead of 201.
validation_rules: If provided must be UUID v4. Deduplicate within 24h window per user.

description: Ring firmware version at time of measurement. Read from BLE characteristic after each connection.
Ring hardware version at time of measurement.

sdk_field: ReadHeartRateRsp.mUtcTime (int, Unix seconds) * 1000 for continuous. System.currentTimeMillis() at callback for manual.
description: Measurement time on device. SDK mUtcTime is Unix seconds  multiply by 1000 for ms.

sdk_field: StopHeartRateRsp.value (int) for manual via manualModeHeart. ReadHeartRateRsp.mHeartRateArray[i] (byte, unsigned) for continuous  one point per 5 min. Convert: val bpm = byteVal.toInt() and 0xFF
description: Heart rate in BPM. SDK value field is int for manual. mHeartRateArray is byte[]  unsigned conversion required for continuous.
validation_rules: Range: 30–250. Reject outside. Zero = no reading  do not store.

sdk_field: StopHeartRateRsp.rri (int). Only available on manual measurements.
description: R-to-R interval in ms. Only from manual measurement. Null for continuous.
validation_rules: Range: 200–2000 ms. Null if continuous or not available.

sdk_field: BloodOxygenEntity.unix_time (long, Unix seconds) * 1000 for continuous. System.currentTimeMillis() for manual.
description: Measurement time. BloodOxygenEntity.unix_time is Unix seconds  multiply by 1000.

sdk_field: StopHeartRateRsp.bloodOxygen (int) for manual via manualModeSpO2. BloodOxygenEntity.minArray[hour] or maxArray[hour] (List<Integer>) for hourly continuous  one entry per hour, 24 total. IntervalBloodOxygenEntity.array (List<Integer>) for interval mode  one per minute.
description: Blood oxygen saturation. SDK returns int directly (not byte) for manual. For continuous hourly, store average of min+max per hour.
validation_rules: Range: 70–100. Values below 70 physiologically implausible  reject. Zero = sensor error, do not store.

description: Distinguishes hourly summary from interval per-minute data.

sdk_field: IntervalBloodOxygenEntity.interval (int). Null for manual or hourly.
description: Measurement interval in minutes for interval mode only.
validation_rules: Range: 1–60. Null if manual or hourly.

description: Day offset for interval mode sync. Null for manual.

sdk_field: StopHeartRateRsp callback time (manual) | BlePressure.time (long, Unix seconds) * 1000 for synced manual history
description: Measurement time. BlePressure.time is Unix seconds  multiply by 1000.

sdk_field: StopHeartRateRsp.sbp (int) for manual measurement result. Also derivable via CalcBloodPressureByHeart.cal_sbp(hr, age) from StopHeartRateRsp.value. BlePressure.sbp (int) for synced history.
description: Systolic BP in mmHg. CRITICAL: The ring does NOT measure BP optically. StopHeartRateRsp.sbp is SDK-calculated from the HR signal. This limitation must be disclosed in any UI.

sdk_field: StopHeartRateRsp.dbp (int) for manual. Also: CalcBloodPressureByHeart.cal_dbp(sbp). BlePressure.dbp (int) for synced history.
description: Diastolic BP in mmHg. SDK-derived from systolic.

sdk_field: StopHeartRateRsp.value (int)  the raw HR reading input to BP derivation. Store for auditability.
description: The HR value used as input to BP formula. Stored so derivation can be audited or recalculated.

validation_rules: Allowed: manual_ring (from manualModeBP) | auto_hourly (from CMD_BP_TIMING_MONITOR_DATA synced via BpDataEntity)

sdk_field: TemperatureOnceEntity.mTime (long, Unix seconds) * 1000 for manual once. TemperatureEntity: cursor_index * mTimeSpan * 60 * 1000 + day_start_ms for continuous. StopHeartRateRsp callback time for manualThreeTemperature.
description: Measurement time. TemperatureOnceEntity.mTime is Unix seconds  multiply by 1000.

sdk_field: TemperatureOnceEntity.mValue (float) for manual once  already Celsius. TemperatureEntity.mValues[i] (float) for continuous auto series. IntervalTemperature.value1 (float) from manualThreeTemperature or syncIntervalThreeTemperatureWithCallback. StopHeartRateRsp.temperature (int) / 100.0 for one-click measurement.
description: Primary sensor temperature in Celsius. Already in Celsius for TemperatureOnceEntity and IntervalTemperature. StopHeartRateRsp.temperature requires divide by 100.
validation_rules: Range: 30.0–45.0. Reject outside. Zero = sensor error, do not store.

sdk_field: TemperatureEntity.mSideValues[i] (float) for continuous. TemperatureOnceEntity.mSideValues (float) for manual once. IntervalTemperature.value2 (float) for three-point.
description: Secondary sensor temperature. Null for single-sensor measurements.

sdk_field: TemperatureEntity.mSideValues1[i] (float) for continuous. TemperatureOnceEntity.mSideValues1 (float) for manual once. IntervalTemperature.value3 (float) for three-point.
description: Tertiary sensor temperature. Null for single-sensor measurements.
Which SDK path produced this reading.
validation_rules: Allowed: manual_once (startObtainTemperatureOnce) | auto_series (startObtainTemperatureSeries) | three_point (manualThreeTemperature) | interval (syncIntervalThreeTemperatureWithCallback) | one_click (oneClickMeasurement)

sdk_field: TemperatureEntity.mTimeSpan (int)  measurement interval in minutes for continuous series.
description: Interval between readings for auto_series mode. Null for manual modes.
Day offset for interval sync. Null for manual.

sdk_field: System.currentTimeMillis() at callback for manual. HRVRsp.today (DateUtil) + range offset for continuous history.
StopHeartRateRsp.hrv (int) for manual via manualModeHrv. HRVRsp.pressureArray[i] (byte[]) / 10 for synced history via HRVReq  SDK returns raw byte array, divide each element by 10 for actual value.
description: HRV RMSSD in milliseconds. For synced history: HRVRsp.pressureArray is a byte array  divide each byte by 10 to get the display value. For manual: StopHeartRateRsp.hrv is already the int value.
validation_rules: Range: 1–300. Reject zero for manual (errCode must be 0). Reject > 300.

sdk_field: HRVRsp.range (int)  interval between readings, typically 30 minutes.
description: Measurement interval for synced history. Null for manual.
Day offset used during sync. Null if manual.

sdk_field: System.currentTimeMillis() at callback for manual. PressureRsp.today + range offset for synced history.
StopHeartRateRsp.stress (int) for manual via manualModePressure. PressureRsp.pressureArray[i] (byte[]) / 10 for synced history via PressureReq  same pattern as HRVRsp.
description: Stress/pressure index 0–100. For synced history: PressureRsp.pressureArray byte array, divide each element by 10. Manual: StopHeartRateRsp.stress is the int value directly.
validation_rules: Range: 0–100. Reject outside. Zero from manual with errCode != 0 means failed  do not store.

description: Measurement interval for synced history. Null for manual.
Day offset used during sync. Null if manual.

sdk_field: Derived from BleStepTotal.year, month, day fields  convert to midnight UTC milliseconds of that date.
description: Date of activity as midnight UTC of the calendar day. One record per day.
validation_rules: Must be midnight-aligned UTC. Reject duplicate dates per user.

description: Total step count for the day. Cumulative from midnight.
Aerobic step subset of total. Must be <= steps.
Walking/running distance for the day in meters.

sdk_field: BleStepTotal.calorie (int)  IMPORTANT: SDK unit is small calories (cal). Android must divide by 1000 before sending to API to convert to kcal.
description: Calories burned in kcal. SDK field calorie is in small calories  divide by 1000 for kcal. Do not store raw SDK value.
Time in active movement for the day in seconds.

sdk_field: BleStepTotal.sleepDuration (int)  rough figure from activity summary, not from sleep sensor detail.
description: Sleep duration from activity summary. Not the detailed sleep record  see sleep table. Null if not available.
How many days ago relative to sync time. Used to validate device_timestamp alignment.

sdk_field: Derived: date midnight UTC ms + (BleStepDetails.timeIndex * 15 * 60 * 1000). Year/month/day also provided by BleStepDetails directly.
validation_rules: Must be 15-min aligned. Range: 0–95 for timeIndex.

sdk_field: BleStepDetails.timeIndex (int)  15-min slot index. 0=00:00 to 00:15, 95=23:45 to 00:00. One data point per 15-min window.
BleStepDetails.runSteps (int)  SDK notes this field as "keep for now" suggesting future use.
description: Running step count in this window. May be zero or unreliable per SDK documentation.
Distance in this 15-minute window in meters.

sdk_field: BleStepDetails.calorie (int)  SDK unit is small calories (cal). Store as-is for detail table. Convert to kcal (/1000) only in API responses.
description: Calories in small calories (cal). Different from activity table which stores kcal. Stored raw here.
Relative day offset used during sync.

sdk_field: SleepNewProtoResp.st (int, Unix seconds) * 1000  sleep session start time.
description: When sleep session started. SDK st is Unix seconds  multiply by 1000.
Sleep session start in Unix ms. Same value as device_timestamp. Stored explicitly for direct query.
Sleep session end in Unix ms. SDK et is Unix seconds  multiply by 1000.

sdk_field: Sum of SleepNewProtoResp.list where DetailBean.t == 3. d field = duration in minutes.
description: Deep sleep minutes. Summed from stage detail list type=3.

sdk_field: Sum of SleepNewProtoResp.list where DetailBean.t == 2. d = duration minutes.
description: Light sleep minutes. Type=2 (shallowDuration in SleepDisplay maps to this).

sdk_field: Sum of SleepNewProtoResp.list where DetailBean.t == 4. d = duration minutes.
description: REM sleep minutes. Type=4 (rapidDuration in SleepDisplay).

sdk_field: Sum of SleepNewProtoResp.list where DetailBean.t == 5. d = duration minutes.
description: Awake time during sleep session. Type=5.

sdk_field: Sum of SleepNewProtoResp.list where DetailBean.t == 1 (ring removed).
description: Minutes ring was removed during sleep window. Type=1. Null if none detected.
validation_rules: Range: 0–600. Null if t==1 not present.

description: Total session duration. Server-derived  not sent by Android.
validation_rules: Must equal sum of stage minutes. Range: 1–1440.

sdk_field: SleepDisplay.wakingCount (int)  number of times woke during sleep. Only available when using SleepDisplay callback path.
description: Number of wake events. From SleepDisplay (ILargeDataSleepResponse) callback. Null if using SleepNewProtoResp path only.

sdk_field: SleepNewProtoResp.lunchSt (int) * 1000. Only present when lunchBreak == true.
description: Nap start time if detected. Null if no nap (lunchBreak = false).
Nap end time. Null if no nap.
Relative day offset used during sync.

validation_rules: Must reference valid sleep.id for same user.

sdk_field: SleepNewProtoResp.DetailBean.t (int). Values: 0=not sleeping, 1=ring removed, 2=light sleep, 3=deep sleep, 4=eye movement/REM, 5=awake.
description: Stage type code from SDK. Matches SDK documentation exactly.

validation_rules: Allowed: none | removed | light | deep | rem | awake

sdk_field: SleepNewProtoResp.DetailBean.d (int)  duration of this stage segment in minutes.
description: Duration of this stage segment in minutes.

sdk_field: SportPlusEntity.mStartTime (int, Unix seconds) * 1000. Also available as trainingStartTime (String) in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm format set via SportPlusHandle.timeFormat.
description: Session start time. mStartTime is Unix seconds  multiply by 1000.
Session end time derived from start + duration.

sdk_field: SportPlusEntity.mSportType (int). See sport_type_map table for all codes.
validation_rules: Must be a known code per sport_type_map. Store unknown codes as-is with label Other.

description: Distance in meters. Null for stationary activities.

sdk_field: SportPlusEntity.mCalories (float). IMPORTANT: SDK type is float in small calories. Divide by 1000 for kcal in API responses.
description: Calories in small calories. mCalories is a float  store full precision. Divide by 1000 for kcal in responses.

sdk_field: SportPlusEntity.mSpeedAvg (int). Divide by 100 for m/s, multiply by 3.6 for km/h in API responses.
description: Average speed in cm/s. Raw SDK unit.

sdk_field: SportPlusEntity.steps (int). Only populated for step-based activities.
description: Step count. Only for walking/running/hiking (type 3,4,7,8,41,60). Zero for others per SDK notes.

sdk_field: SportPlusEntity.mElevation (int). Divide by 100 for metres in API responses.
SportPlusEntity.mSportCount (int). Meaning varies by sport type.
description: Repetition count (e.g. rope skips, swim laps). Sport-type dependent.

validation_rules: One user can register multiple devices.

sdk_field: BluetoothDevice.address from BleScannerHelper scan callback or BleOperateManager.connectStatue
description: Bluetooth MAC address. Primary device identifier.
validation_rules: Format: XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX uppercase colon-separated. Unique per user.

sdk_field: BluetoothDevice.name from scan callback or connectStatue callback
Constants.CHAR_FIRMWARE_REVISION BLE characteristic read via onCharacteristicRead in QCBluetoothCallbackCloneReceiver
description: Latest firmware version. Updated on each connection.

sdk_field: Constants.CHAR_HW_REVISION BLE characteristic read via onCharacteristicRead

description: Last known battery 0–100. Updated on sync.
Whether ring is currently charging. Updated with battery reading.
Ring capability flag from SDK. Read after connection.
Server time of last successful sync.

validation_rules: Valid email. Max 254 chars. Unique. Lowercase enforced.

description: bcrypt hash. Never log or return.
validation_rules: bcrypt cost >= 12. Never in API responses.

description: User age. Used as input to CalcBloodPressureByHeart.cal_sbp(hr, age). Required for accurate BP derivation.
validation_rules: Range: 1–120. Should be set before any BP measurements.

description: User height in cm. Synced to ring via TimeFormatReq.
User weight in kg. Synced to ring.

sdk_field: TimeFormatReq: mSex param 0=male 1=female. UserProfileRsp.gender (boolean)  true=male false=female.
description: Gender as boolean. True=male, false=female. Maps to UserProfileRsp.gender (boolean) confirmed in bytecode.
Ring display time format. True=24h, false=12h.
Daily step goal synced to ring.

sdk_field: TargetSettingReq calorie param  IMPORTANT: SDK expects small calories. Multiply goal_calories_kcal * 1000 before passing to SDK.
description: Daily calorie burn goal in kcal. Must multiply by 1000 when writing to ring via TargetSettingReq.

sdk_field: TimeFormatReq sbp param (baseline systolic for BP calibration) | UserProfileRsp.sbp (int)
description: Baseline systolic BP used to calibrate ring BP derivation. Recommended to set for accuracy.
Idempotency key for the entire batch. Android generates before sending. Safe to retry  server processes once within 24h window.
validation_rules: UUID v4. Deduplicate within 24h per user.

description: Array of health records of any supported type. Each element must include a type field.
validation_rules: Max 500 records per batch. Max payload 5 MB.

description: Tells the API which table to route the record to.
validation_rules: Allowed: heart_rate | spo2 | blood_pressure | temperature | hrv | stress | activity | activity_detail | sleep | sport_session

description: Earliest device_timestamp across all records in batch. Helps server validate batch sanity.
Latest device_timestamp across all records in batch.
